title: MUSE: An Interactive Meta-Agent for Understanding and Steering LLM-powered Data Science Systems
authors: Wei-Hao Chen, Weixi Tong, Yuan Tian, Chenglong Wang, Tianyi Zhang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Recent advances in large language models have enabled a new class of agentic data science systems that allow users to complete complex data science workflows through natural language. Although these systems can significantly reduce manual effort, it remains difficult to diagnose their behavior and steer the reasoning process when failures or unexpected outputs occur. We present MUSE, an interactive meta-agent that enhances user understanding and control of agentic data science systems by (1) dynamically restructuring low-level execution traces into multiple semantic levels that support navigation from high-level overviews to low-level implementation details; (2) enabling users to reference specific workflow steps in context to ask grounded questions, provide feedback, and revise problematic steps without manually locating relevant execution history; and (3) supporting mixed-initiative steering by surfacing suspicious steps for inspection, scaffolding the repair process, and translating user repair intent into contextualized instructions for the underlying agent. In a between-subjects study (n = 15), MUSE improved task efficiency and increased users' confidence in understanding and steering agentic data science workflows.
title_zh: MUSE：一种交互式元智能体，用于理解和引导由大语言模型驱动的数据科学系统
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的最新进展催生了一类新的智能体数据科学系统，使用户能够通过自然语言完成复杂的数据科学工作流。尽管这些系统可以显著减少人工投入，但当出现故障或意外输出时，仍难以诊断其行为并引导推理过程。我们提出了MUSE，一个交互式元智能体，它通过以下方式增强用户对智能体数据科学系统的理解和控制：（1）将低层执行轨迹动态重构为多个语义层次，支持从高层概览到低层实现细节的导航；（2）使用户能够在上下文中引用特定的工作流步骤，提出有据可依的问题、提供反馈并修改有问题的步骤，而无需手动定位相关的执行历史；（3）通过呈现可疑步骤供检查、为修复过程搭建支架，并将用户的修复意图转化为针对底层智能体的情境化指令，从而支持混合主动引导。在一项受试者间研究（n = 15）中，MUSE提高了任务效率，并增强了用户理解和引导智能体数据科学工作流的信心。

title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
authors: Giuseppe Destefanis, Tomaso Aste
publish: arXiv
abstract: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.
title_zh: 当智能体协调时：衡量多智能体AI编程中的协调性
abstract_zh: 我们研究了 AI 编程代理团队在解决编程任务时如何进行协调。当前的评估通常只报告代理是否完成任务以及运行成本，而团队内部的协调在很大程度上未被衡量。我们引入了一种工具来衡量这种协调。每次运行都被表示为一个时间网络，其中代理和文件是节点，消息、文件写入和文件读取是带时间戳的有向边，并带有相关的成本。我们将该工具应用于 1902 次运行，每次运行都用固定的测试套件进行评估，配置涵盖不同的团队规模、团队结构和文件策略。由此产生的网络展示了协调如何随团队壮大和工作变化而改变。直接消息传递最初随代理数量接近二次方地增长，其中大部分增长来自于早期的一轮介绍。随着团队进一步壮大，在我们研究的最大团队中，这种增长趋于平稳，代理们越来越多地通过广播消息进行交流。任务也会塑造最终形成的网络。围绕共享规范构建的工作会产生密集、高度互联的团队，而流水线任务则会产生围绕局部接口组织的稀疏网络。共享文件可以取代重复的一对一通信，在八名代理处理消息密集型工作时将输出词元减少约 42%，而在文件已经承担协调作用时则会增加开销。指定一名代理作为协调者并不会形成通信枢纽，也不会可靠地提高成功率。我们还观察到代理自发地去寻找隐藏评分材料的倾向。我们在封闭环境中重复了关键实验条件，将隐藏材料替换为带有标记的占位文件。在额外的 244 次运行中，代理在五分之四的运行中仍然会去获取它，而协调者和文件通道的发现也得到了复现。

title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
authors: Hongyue Yu, Kefan Li, Jiakun Li, Hongzheng Chai, Yuan Yuan, Rui He, Junyi Wei
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generation. TDD-Agent first prompts the model to generate executable tests, encouraging it to clarify expected behaviors before implementation, and then performs iterative dual-track refinement over both the generated code and tests using execution feedback. We first isolate the effect of test-first reasoning through a prompt variant TDD-prompt on LiveCodeBench, where it consistently improves upon reasoning-based prompting baselines. Building on this finding, we evaluate the full TDD-Agent framework on RepoEval, a repository-level benchmark, and show that it consistently outperforms retrieval-based and agent-based baselines. Additional analyses show that iterative refinement improves not only code correctness but also the effectiveness of the generated tests, yielding higher pass rates, coverage, and mutation scores, suggesting that tests can serve as evolving reasoning artifacts rather than fixed validators. Our source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TDD-Agent-Framework-6370/.
title_zh: TDD智能体：面向代码生成的测试驱动推理
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在代码生成方面取得了显著进展，但确保复杂仓库级任务的正确性仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常将生成的测试用作静态事后验证器，这限制了其引导实现的能力，并且当测试本身不完整或错误时，可能会引入误导性反馈。在本文中，我们提出了TDD-Agent，它将测试驱动开发范式操作化地应用于代码生成。TDD-Agent首先提示模型生成可执行的测试，鼓励其在实现之前明确预期行为，然后利用执行反馈对生成的代码和测试进行迭代式双轨细化。我们首先通过提示变体TDD-prompt在LiveCodeBench上分离了测试优先推理的效应，结果表明它持续优于基于推理的提示基线。在此基础上，我们在仓库级基准测试RepoEval上评估了完整的TDD-Agent框架，并展示了它持续优于基于检索和基于智能体的基线。进一步的分析表明，迭代细化不仅提高了代码的正确性，还提升了所生成测试的有效性，带来了更高的通过率、覆盖率和变异得分，这表明测试可以作为不断演化的推理产物，而非固定的验证器。我们的源代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TDD-Agent-Framework-6370/ 获取。

title: Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM
authors: Zigan Zhou, Kai Li, Yupeng Deng
publish: arXiv
abstract: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.
title_zh: 基于MLLM的遥感城市布局提取
abstract_zh: 遥感系统通常使用检测框、语义掩膜或矢量边界来描述城市内容。此类输出能够定位类别并支持图像平面评分，但其本身并不构成可执行的布局，无法保留对象身份、类型化关系、拓扑和再生规则。相反，Code-as-City 将单张俯视图像中的城市布局提取视为一种受约束的代码生成任务，并借助多模态大语言模型（MLLM）实现。首先，图像模型生成一个对齐的五类语义布局先验；随后，三个有序的 MLLM 阶段利用图像与该先验来恢复道路、土地覆盖区域及其关系，以及建筑物。确定性归一化将累积的记录转换为城市图和一个受限的布局程序。执行该程序会生成可渲染的 3D 城市布局，并在共享几何上产生一个正交语义投影。该投影可与遥感掩膜进行像素级比较，同时命名对象、关系和编辑操作仍可用于同步重建两个视图。在 CityLayout-100 的 100 个场景上评估，完整框架取得了 41.1% 的平均交并比（mIoU）和 48.3% 的全局交并比（gIoU）。这一结果提供了定量证据，表明视觉观测可被转化为可检查、可编辑的城市代码，并生成耦合的平面与 3D 输出。

title: Proving the Utility of Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Simulations: A Comprehensive Examination
authors: Stylianos Kampakis, Fabio Rovai, Marcos Charalambides, Theodosis Mourouzis, Chris Hicks
publish: arXiv
abstract: Cyber threats continue to escalate in both frequency and sophistication, necessitating more adaptive and scalable defense strategies. This paper explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) can bolster cybersecurity simulations by automating the creation of synthetic environments and identifying latent vulnerabilities. We employ YAML as a structured representation format for simulating complex network configurations, thereby enabling Large Language Model-driven pipelines to support and improve reinforcement learning (RL) agent training. Comparative studies examine the advantages of LLM-based techniques over classical approaches such as Double Q-learning with Prioritized Experience Replay (PER), emphasizing increased efficiency, higher adaptability, and enhanced realism in cyberattack simulations. In empirical benchmarks across multiple synthetic topologies, LLM-instantiated Python agents achieved up to a 94.5% compromise rate while executing in 0.02-0.06 seconds per assessment---a ~25,000x to 50,000x speedup over traditional RL training cycles. Our findings underscore the transformative potential of integrating LLMs into cybersecurity research, ultimately paving the way for more intelligent and robust cyber-defense systems.
title_zh: 证明大型语言模型在网络安全模拟中的实用性：一项全面考察
abstract_zh: 网络威胁在频率和复杂性上持续升级，亟需更具适应性和可扩展性的防御策略。本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）如何通过自动化创建合成环境并识别潜在漏洞来增强网络安全模拟。我们采用YAML作为结构化表示格式，用于模拟复杂网络配置，从而让大型语言模型驱动的流水线能够支持并改进强化学习（RL）智能体的训练。对比研究考察了基于LLM的技术相较于传统方法（如采用优先经验回放（PER）的双Q学习）的优势，强调了在网络攻击模拟中更高的效率、更强的适应性和更逼真的表现。在跨多个合成拓扑的实证基准测试中，由LLM实例化的Python智能体实现了高达94.5%的攻破率，同时每次评估执行仅需0.02至0.06秒——相比传统RL训练周期实现了约25,000倍至50,000倍的加速。我们的研究结果凸显了将LLM整合进网络安全研究的变革潜力，最终为更智能、更稳健的网络防御系统铺平道路。

title: Towards Risk-free AI Agent Deployment
authors: Yintong Huo, Rangeet Pan, Abhik Roychoudhury
publish: arXiv
abstract: LLM-based agents are rapidly moving from research prototypes into the core business processes of organizations, but these agents pose deployment risks to security, compliance, and functionality. In this article, we argue that risk-free deployment must be grounded in the agent's trajectory: the recorded sequence of reasoning steps, tool invocations, and environmental observations. Trajectories are available for any agent, and many failures are visible only in the trajectory. To make agents deployable and sustainable, we advocate agent testing and debugging as a systematic research direction for detecting and mitigating these risks. This article begins with the challenges of testing agents, including the oracle problem, non-determinism, trajectory validation, and the absence of adequacy metrics. We then turn to debugging agents, from automated failure attribution to repair and self-evolution. We distill these directions into a practical deployment-readiness checklist covering the full deployment lifecycle. Finally, we identify open problems, i.e., formal adequacy metrics, root-cause attribution over long-horizon trajectories, and the reliability of self-evolving agents, that the community must address to enable trustworthy agent deployment.
title_zh: 迈向无风险的AI Agent部署
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型的智能体正迅速从研究原型走向组织的核心业务流程，但这些智能体在安全性、合规性和功能性方面带来了部署风险。在本文中，我们认为无风险部署必须建立在智能体的轨迹之上，即推理步骤、工具调用和环境观察的序列化记录。任何智能体都可以获取轨迹，而且许多失败只有在轨迹中才可见。为了使智能体可部署且可持续，我们倡导将智能体测试与调试作为一个系统性的研究方向，以检测和缓解这些风险。本文首先探讨了智能体测试面临的挑战，包括预言机问题、非确定性、轨迹验证以及充分性指标的缺失。接着，我们转向智能体的调试，从自动化失败归因到修复与自我进化。我们将这些方向提炼为一份涵盖完整部署生命周期的实用部署就绪检查清单。最后，我们指出了社区必须解决的关键开放问题，即形式化充分性指标、长时程轨迹的根因归因以及自进化智能体的可靠性，以实现可信赖的智能体部署。

title: Security Assessment of DeepSeek Harness with A.I.G: Evaluating Resistance to Indirect Prompt Injection
authors: Zonghao Ying, Xiangfan Wu, Huiyu Wu, Xing Zheng, Huangsheng Cheng, Xiaorong Shi, Jing Guo
publish: arXiv
abstract: We assess indirect prompt injection in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) to construct tests, deliver controlled taint, execute DSH, collect traces, and judge outcomes. The study covers 14,560 controlled executions over 16 indirect-content channels, text and file carrier modes, 35 payload objectives, one unmodified baseline, and 12 attack methods. The experiment preserves DSH's agent loop, tool registry, model adapter, and session-event path; source tools and sensitive sinks are local fixtures, so attempted actions are recorded without external side effects. We evaluate each trace with a deterministic rule-based judge, \JudgeR{} (RuleJudge), and a semantic LLM-based judge, \JudgeL{} (LLMJudge). The strongest observed attack success rates are 17.0% under \JudgeL{} for fake-completion attack in text mode, 25.5% under \JudgeR{} for hidden Unicode in file mode, and 16.0% under \JudgeR{} for the skills channel in file mode. \JudgeL{} also assigns partial compliance more often than \JudgeR{} (7.3% versus 2.0%). We relate these results to DSH's treatment of tool results, additional contexts, and tool-call policy hooks, then identify controls that should sit between untrusted content and sensitive actions. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard.
title_zh: DeepSeek Harness 与 A.I.G 的安全评估：针对间接提示注入的抵抗能力评估
abstract_zh: 我们评估 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 中的间接提示注入，使用 AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) 来构造测试、注入受控污点、执行 DSH、收集轨迹并判定结果。该研究涵盖 14,560 次受控执行，涉及 16 个间接内容通道、文本和文件载体模式、35 个载荷目标、1 个未修改基线以及 12 种攻击方法。实验保留了 DSH 的代理循环、工具注册表、模型适配器和会话事件路径；源工具和敏感汇聚点均为本地测试夹具，因此尝试的操作会被记录而不会产生外部副作用。我们使用确定性基于规则的评判器 \JudgeR{} (RuleJudge) 和基于语义的 LLM 评判器 \JudgeL{} (LLMJudge) 对每条轨迹进行评估。观察到的最强攻击成功率分别是：文本模式下假完成攻击在 \JudgeL{} 下为 17.0%，文件模式下隐藏 Unicode 在 \JudgeR{} 下为 25.5%，文件模式下技能通道在 \JudgeR{} 下为 16.0%。\JudgeL{} 也比 \JudgeR{} 更频繁地赋予部分合规（7.3% 对 2.0%）。我们将这些结果与 DSH 对工具结果、附加上下文和工具调用策略挂钩的处理方式联系起来，然后确定了应置于不受信任内容与敏感操作之间的控制措施。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard 获取。

title: Bounded Semantic Planning and Deterministic Compilation for Reliable Enterprise Text-to-SQL
authors: Yi Ai
publish: arXiv
abstract: Direct text-to-SQL asks a language model to do two jobs: interpret the business question and construct the complete relational query. In enterprise schemas, SQL can execute successfully while using the wrong relationship role or aggregation grain. We study an alternative placement of the stochastic boundary. A multi-turn planner grounds phrases and selects from question-specific governed options; graph traversal, role predicates, grain lowering, SQL construction, and deterministic checks are implemented in code. We evaluate this semantic path compilation (SPC) system against direct DDL-to-SQL generation on the ACME insurance benchmark. On a 38-question adjudicated comparison set with three runs per question, SPC was adjudicated correct on every run for 37 questions (97.4%), compared with 21 (55.3%) for the baseline. The paired discordance was 16 questions in favor of SPC and none in favor of the baseline (two-sided exact McNemar p=3.05x10^-5). SPC answered all 38 questions correctly at least once and produced one refusal and no adjudicated wrong-but-executed run across 114 run outcomes; the baseline produced 29 adjudicated wrong runs and seven additional judge-flagged data-only coincidences on the same set. A strict-equivalence sensitivity analysis increased the paired difference. Additional SPC runs with GPT-5.4 and Gemini-3.6-Flash showed similar question-level robustness, although their per-run verdict artifacts were not preserved. Six additional benchmark items are retained in an all-item analysis and documented separately by failure class. The study supports an end-to-end systems result, not a causal claim that compilation alone produced the gain, because SPC receives governed semantic artifacts that the DDL baseline does not.
title_zh: 面向可靠企业级文本到SQL的有界语义规划与确定性编译
abstract_zh: 直接文本到 SQL 要求语言模型完成两项工作：解释业务问题并构造完整的关系查询。在企业模式中，SQL 可能在使用了错误的关系角色或聚合粒度时仍然成功执行。我们研究了随机性边界的一种替代布置方式。一个多轮规划器将短语进行语义落地，并从特定于问题的受控候选项中进行选择；图遍历、角色谓词、粒度降低、SQL 构造和确定性检查都在代码中实现。我们在 ACME 保险基准上，将这种语义路径编译（SPC）系统与直接的 DDL 到 SQL 生成进行比较。在一个包含 38 个问题、每问题三次运行的裁定比较集上，SPC 在 37 个问题（97.4%）的每次运行中都被裁定正确，而基线为 21 个（55.3%）。配对不一致为 16 个问题支持 SPC，0 个支持基线（双侧精确 McNemar p=3.05x10^-5）。SPC 在全部 38 个问题上至少正确回答了一次，并在 114 次运行结果中产生了一次拒绝，且没有出现被裁定为错误但已执行的运行；基线在同一集合上产生了 29 次被裁定错误的运行，以及 7 次额外的、由法官标记为仅属数据巧合的情况。一项严格等价敏感性分析增大了配对差异。使用 GPT-5.4 和 Gemini-3.6-Flash 的额外 SPC 运行显示出类似的问题级稳健性，尽管其逐次运行的裁定产物未被保留。另外六个基准项目保留在全项目分析中，并按失败类别分别记录。该研究支持一个端到端的系统结果，而非一个因果性主张——即仅靠编译本身产生了该增益，因为 SPC 接收了 DDL 基线所没有的受控语义产物。

title: Executable Code Knowledge: Code as a Native, Validation-Carrying Knowledge Representation for AI Coding Agents
authors: Xueping Gao
publish: arXiv
abstract: AI coding agents need more than relevant snippets: they need business semantics, validation evidence, relations, and assurance that their context is current. Existing systems usually infer or externalize this knowledge through retrieval, summaries, graphs, rules, or reverse specifications. We investigate a complementary representation in which selected code units directly carry agent-usable knowledge. We introduce Executable Code Knowledge (ECK) and define an Executable Code Knowledge Unit (ECKU) as a source-bound object combining stable identity, semantics, executable behavior, contracts, evidence, relations, provenance, validation state, and a query interface. Our Python prototype supports code-local authoring, manifest export, evidence execution, exact changed-line impact, freshness checking, and agent-facing projections. Across three real Python repositories and 26 controlled patch tasks, direct ECK provides executable test coverage for 11/11 evidence-bearing tasks and exact selectors for 9/11; hiding declared evidence reduces exact recovery to 1/11 (paired exact McNemar p=0.0078). ECK-derived rules recover 11/11 exact selectors, showing that rules are effective delivery artifacts while ECK supplies source binding, validation state, impact, and freshness. Exact changed-line impact matches independently authored labels on all 26 patches (12 unit links; precision, recall, and F1 all 1.000). AST-bounded fingerprints classify 50 positive changes and 17 unrelated same-file controls correctly, whereas static rules snapshots detect none of the 50 stale cases. Model-backed patch-review and cross-layer studies measure projection fidelity rather than independent impact discovery. These results support a hybrid architecture: retrieval for coverage, ECK for source and evidence governance, and projections for delivery.
title_zh: 可执行代码知识：将代码作为面向AI编程智能体的原生、携带验证的知识表示
abstract_zh: AI 编程智能体需要的不仅仅是相关代码片段：它们还需要业务语义、验证证据、关系以及对其上下文是最新的保证。现有系统通常通过检索、摘要、图、规则或逆向规格说明来推断或外部化这些知识。我们研究了一种互补表示，其中选定的代码单元直接携带智能体可用的知识。我们引入了可执行代码知识（ECK），并将可执行代码知识单元（ECKU）定义为与源代码绑定的对象，它结合了稳定身份、语义、可执行行为、契约、证据、关系、来源、验证状态和查询接口。我们的 Python 原型支持代码本地编写、清单导出、证据执行、精确变更行影响、新鲜度检查以及面向智能体的投影。在三个真实的 Python 代码库和 26 个受控补丁任务中，直接使用 ECK 为 11/11 个带证据的任务提供了可执行测试覆盖，并为 9/11 个任务提供了精确选择器；隐藏声明的证据将精确恢复率降低到 1/11（配对精确 McNemar 检验 p=0.0078）。从 ECK 推导出的规则恢复了 11/11 个精确选择器，表明规则是有效的交付工件，而 ECK 提供源代码绑定、验证状态、影响和新鲜度。精确变更行影响与独立编写的标签在所有 26 个补丁上匹配（12 个单元链接；精确率、召回率和 F1 均为 1.000）。AST 限定的指纹正确分类了 50 个正向变更和 17 个无关的同文件对照，而静态规则快照未能检测到 50 个过期案例中的任何一个。基于模型的补丁审查和跨层研究衡量的是投影保真度，而非独立的影响发现。这些结果支持一种混合架构：检索用于覆盖，ECK 用于源代码和证据治理，投影用于交付。

title: Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization
authors: Yixuan Wang, Yifei Chen, Haichao Zhang, Haozheng Luo, Xander Wu, Jie Ni, Yun Fu, Nuno Vasconcelos, Yijiang Li
publish: arXiv
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. As a result, training continues to allocate gradient budget to already-solved objectives instead of focusing on those with greater remaining headroom. We introduce \textbf{Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization} (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This dynamically reallocates optimization effort toward under-optimized objectives while empirically maintaining performance on those that are already well satisfied. We further show that saturation-aware reweighting can reverse the sign of an update, rather than merely rescale its magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels.
title_zh: 学习未掌握的，而非已精通的：面向多奖励策略优化的饱和感知优势重加权
abstract_zh: 使用组相对优势的强化学习（RL）已成为语言模型推理器后训练的事实标准。然而，在优化多个奖励目标时，现有方法通常先使用固定加权和将奖励向量标量化，再进行分组标准化。我们表明，这种设计会导致两个根本性问题：具有不同奖励画像的轨迹可能获得相同的优势值，并且所有目标都以固定的相对权重进行优化，而不考虑它们当前的饱和程度。其结果是，训练会继续将梯度预算分配给已经解决的目标，而不是专注于那些剩余空间更大的目标。我们提出了**饱和感知的多奖励策略优化优势重加权**（SA-MRPO），该方法独立地对每个奖励目标进行标准化，并根据批次级别的目标饱和估计自适应地折扣其贡献。这能够动态地将优化努力重新分配给优化不足的目标，同时在经验上保持那些已得到充分满足的目标的性能。我们进一步表明，饱和感知重加权可以反转更新的符号，而不仅仅是重新缩放其幅度。在双目标和三目标奖励组合的数学推理实验中，SA-MRPO 在 15 项基准比较中有 12 项优于 GDPO 的更难的正确性目标，在 AIME24 上提升最高达 5%。在自适应推理中，它提升了全部五个基准的准确率，平均提升 3.8%，在 AMC23 上最高提升 9.2%；在编程基准中，通过率最高提升 2.3%，而在所有设置下，较容易的目标均保持在其已满足的水平附近。

title: TRACE: Traversal and Reasoning Algebraic Computing Engine for Formal Hardware Verification
authors: Jan Kleinekathöfer, Lennart Weingarten, Kamalika Datta, Rolf Drechsler
publish: arXiv
abstract: Modern hardware verification of complex circuits relies heavily on the efficiency of formal methods. For complex arithmetic circuits in particular Symbolic Computer Algebra (SCA) engines which represent pseudo-boolean functions using polynomials are crucial. As circuit complexity grows in the age of AI, verification of arithmetic primitives, including Multiplication, Addition, Multiply-Accumulate (MAC), becomes a computational bottleneck. To address this, we introduce TRACE (Traversal and Reasoning Algebraic Computing Engine), a highly efficient framework designed to investigate the intersection of traversal strategies and proof efficiency. Unlike existing SCA tools which are mainly limited to multipliers, TRACE offers a flexible framework for researchers to analyze memory usage and verification time across a wide range of arithmetic circuits (adder, multiplier and MAC). To overcome the state-explosion problem inherent in polynomial expansion, the engine incorporates advanced reduction techniques, including optimized traversal strategies, conflict removal, and polarity-based optimization for compact symbolic representations. Our experimental results show that for optimized MAC, for the first time, TRACE was able to verify previously unverifiable circuits
title_zh: TRACE：用于形式化硬件验证的遍历与推理代数计算引擎
abstract_zh: 现代复杂电路的硬件验证高度依赖形式化方法的效率。特别是对于复杂算术电路，使用多项式表示伪布尔函数的符号计算机代数（SCA）引擎至关重要。随着人工智能时代电路复杂度的不断增长，包括乘法、加法、乘加运算（MAC）在内的算术原语验证已成为计算瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TRACE（遍历与推理代数计算引擎，Traversal and Reasoning Algebraic Computing Engine），一个旨在探究遍历策略与证明效率之间交叉关系的高效框架。与现有主要局限于乘法器的SCA工具不同，TRACE为研究人员提供了一个灵活的框架，用于分析多种算术电路（加法器、乘法器和MAC）的内存占用与验证时间。为克服多项式展开中固有的状态爆炸问题，该引擎融合了先进的化简技术，包括优化的遍历策略、冲突消除以及基于极性的优化，以实现紧凑的符号表示。实验结果表明，对于优化后的MAC电路，TRACE首次成功验证了此前无法验证的电路。

title: Walk Before You Run: The Importance of Data Exploration for Data Analysis Agents
authors: Yike Yuan, Virum Ranka, Tina Lasisi, Lin Ma
publish: arXiv
abstract: LLM-based data-analysis tools are increasingly used to help users analyze messy spreadsheets and workbooks, from answering questions over uploaded files to generating code, summaries, and visualizations. These systems are often evaluated by the correctness of their final downstream answers. However, reliable data analysis also depends on an earlier step: understanding what the dataset contains before solving the requested task. For complex workbooks, this Data Exploration step includes identifying the logical tables behind physical sheets, interpreting column semantics, recovering keys and relationships, and detecting quality issues. In current tools and benchmarks, this step is usually left implicit, creating a gap between downstream task performance and the dataset understanding needed for reliable, human-checkable analysis. Our key contribution is to identify this overlooked gap, make Data Exploration a first-class evaluation target, and show through downstream experiments that stronger Data Exploration support improves task performance. To evaluate dataset understanding directly, we introduce two benchmark settings: a real multi-sheet workbook benchmark based on a Vitamin D study dataset, and an extension of DSBench with schema-fixed Data Exploration artifacts. In both settings, systems are evaluated by the quality of a structured artifact capturing tables, columns, semantic roles, relationships, and profiling signals. Our results show that strong LLMs and data-analysis agents still miss important logical structure even when they read spreadsheet content. Furthermore, explicit Data Exploration support often improves downstream correctness, suggesting it should be treated as a first-class, inspectable stage in LLM data-analysis workflows and a natural human-in-the-loop checkpoint where domain experts can review and correct the artifact before downstream analysis proceeds.
title_zh: 先走后跑：数据探索对数据分析智能体的重要性
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据分析工具正越来越多地被用于帮助用户分析杂乱无章的电子表格和工作簿，其应用范围涵盖从对上传文件进行问答到生成代码、摘要和可视化。这类系统通常根据其最终下游答案的正确性来评估。然而，可靠的数据分析还依赖于一个更早的步骤：在解决所请求的任务之前，先理解数据集包含什么。对于复杂的工作簿而言，这一数据探索步骤包括识别物理工作表背后的逻辑表、解读列语义、恢复键和关系，以及检测数据质量问题。在当前的工具和基准测试中，这一步骤通常被隐式处理，从而在下游任务表现与实现可靠且可人工核查的分析所需的数据集理解之间造成了差距。我们的主要贡献在于识别这一被忽视的差距，将数据探索作为一级评估目标，并通过下游实验证明，更强的数据探索支持能够提升任务表现。为了直接评估数据集理解能力，我们引入了两种基准测试设置：一个基于维生素D研究数据集、包含真实多工作表工作簿的基准测试，以及一个扩展了DSBench并带有模式固定的数据探索产物的设置。在两种设置中，系统均依据其生成的结构化产物的质量进行评估，该产物捕捉了表、列、语义角色、关系和剖析信号。我们的结果表明，即使强大的大语言模型和数据分析代理读取了电子表格内容，它们仍会遗漏重要的逻辑结构。此外，显式的数据探索支持往往能提高下游正确性，这表明数据探索应被视为大语言模型数据分析工作流中一个一级的、可检查的阶段，也是一个自然的、人在回路的检查点，领域专家可以在下游分析继续之前审查并纠正该产物。

title: Revisiting the Performance of Generative Artificial Intelligence on Introductory Object-Oriented Programming Assessments: Insights from 2026
authors: Marina Lepp, Joosep Kaimre
publish: arXiv
abstract: Recent advances in Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) have substantially improved the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate and explain source code. However, their performance on authentic object-oriented programming (OOP) assessments remains insufficiently understood. This study evaluates five widely used GenAI systems, ChatGPT-5.2, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and M365 Copilot, using programming tests and examination tasks from an introductory university OOP course. The generated solutions were assessed using the same grading criteria applied to students and compared with historical student results from the same course, as well as findings from the previous year. Common errors were also analyzed to identify recurring limitations across models. All evaluated GenAI systems achieved higher scores than the average student cohort and frequently obtained full marks on longer programming tasks. Nevertheless, they occasionally produced non-compiling code and continued to struggle with advanced OOP concepts, particularly interfaces, abstract classes, and certain inheritance-related tasks. Performance was also limited on graphics-related questions involving image interpretation. Compared with the previous year, the evaluated systems demonstrated noticeable improvements across most assessments while exhibiting several recurring error patterns. The findings provide an updated evaluation of the capabilities and limitations of contemporary GenAI systems on authentic introductory OOP assessments. They also offer evidence that can inform the design of programming assessments, the responsible integration of GenAI tools into software engineering education, and future studies evaluating the evolution of AI-assisted programming.
title_zh: 重新审视生成式人工智能在入门级面向对象编程评估中的表现：来自2026年的见解
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的最新进展显著提升了大语言模型（LLM）生成和解释源代码的能力。然而，它们在真实面向对象编程（OOP）测评中的表现仍未得到充分理解。本研究使用一门大学入门级OOP课程中的编程测试和考试任务，对五种广泛使用的GenAI系统——ChatGPT-5.2、DeepSeek-V3、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5和M365 Copilot——进行了评估。生成的解决方案采用与学生相同的评分标准进行评定，并与同一课程的历史学生成绩以及前一年的研究结果进行了比较。此外，还分析了常见错误，以识别各模型反复出现的局限性。所有被评估的GenAI系统均取得了高于学生平均水平的分数，并且在较长的编程任务中经常获得满分。尽管如此，它们偶尔仍会生成无法编译的代码，并在高级OOP概念方面持续存在困难，尤其是接口、抽象类以及某些与继承相关的任务。在涉及图像解释的图形相关问题上，性能也受到限制。与前一年相比，所评估的系统在大多数测评中表现出明显进步，同时呈现出若干反复出现的错误模式。本研究对当代GenAI系统在真实入门级OOP测评中的能力与局限性提供了最新评估，也为编程测评设计、GenAI工具在软件工程教育中的负责任整合，以及未来评估AI辅助编程演进的研究提供了实证依据。

title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
authors: Sofoklis Kitharidis, Cor J. Veenman, Jan N. van Rijn, Thomas Bäck, Niki van Stein
publish: arXiv
abstract: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.
title_zh: 使用语言模型演化用于AutoML的可执行流水线程序
abstract_zh: 自动化机器学习（AutoML）系统在由预处理算子、学习器和超参数预先定义的空间内搜索流水线：它们能够选择并调整已知组件，但无法生成该空间之外的结构。我们提出了LACE，一个AutoML框架，它转而搜索完整的可执行流水线程序：一个进化循环维护一组与scikit-learn兼容的Python类群体，而大语言模型充当变异算子。据我们所知，LACE是首个以这种方式构建通用表格流水线AutoML的框架，并在泄漏受控协议下于标准化OpenML任务上进行评估，该协议对生成器隐藏数据集身份。由于每个候选都是普通Python代码，返回的流水线及产生它的搜索过程可以直接检查和编辑，而不仅仅通过框架的模型对象操作。在68个OpenML分类任务上，使用GPT-5.4-mini的LACE显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O以及固定的XGBoost基线，与所评估的最强基于搜索的系统AutoGluon相比无显著差异，同时覆盖了完整的基准测试。较新的表格基础模型在其支持的任务子集上更为准确，但它们应用固定的预训练预测器，而非返回可编辑的任务特定程序。因此，LACE的贡献不在于原始准确率，而在于由代码定义的搜索空间：完整覆盖、从业者可直接复用的流水线，以及通过编辑提示词而非框架来扩展组件集的能力。

title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
authors: Veit Laule, Jiangtao Shuai, Manfred Hauswirth, Sonja Schimmler
publish: arXiv
abstract: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.
title_zh: PDDLCoder：面向LLM辅助符号规划的智能体化PDDL生成
abstract_zh: 大语言模型在长时程规划中仍然不可靠，常常生成逻辑不一致或不可执行的计划。最近的混合方法将自然语言转换为规划域定义语言（PDDL），使符号规划器能够生成可验证的计划。然而，现有方法通常依赖僵化的生成流程、部分PDDL定义或人工反馈。此外，由于缺乏具有自动化验证功能的标准化基准，其评估也受到阻碍。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了PDDLCoder，一个从自然语言生成PDDL的智能体框架，能够迭代地生成、分析和优化规划规范。我们还引入了NL-pddlgym，一个包含23个域、711个规划问题的基准数据集，并提供可执行的gym环境，用于自动化验证计划的适用性。在NL-pddlgym测试集（包含4个留出域中的106个问题）上的实验表明，PDDLCoder为89.6%的测试规划问题生成了可执行计划。相较之下，我们对先前PDDL生成方法的改编版本最高达到45.3%，而直接的LLM规划方法在同一测试集上最高达到74.5%。我们的工作展示了智能体化PDDL生成在规划中的有效性，并为未来LLM辅助符号规划研究建立了可复现的基准。

title: DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design
authors: Xinling Yu, Yixing Li, Ziyue Liu, Xin Ai, Zhiyu Zeng, Hai Li, Zheng Zhang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($κ_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $κ^2$ to $κ$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K to 0.55 K. Second, because optimization leaves the training distribution, we propose a self-improving framework: a hotspot trust gate sends flagged placements to a reference solver, and the surrogate incrementally retrains on the refined solutions, keeping an update only when it improves held-out validation error. On a multi-die benchmark, the surrogate-true peak gap on the returned design falls from 1.12 K to 0.11 K, matching a solve-at-every-step optimizer while running $56\times$ faster.
title_zh: DeepOHeat-v2：用于3D集成电路设计中快速且可信热优化的自改进算子学习
abstract_zh: 面向热感知的多裸片三维集成电路优化需要评估大量设计，而每种设计都涉及一次代价高昂的热方程求解。算子学习替代模型可将该求解替换为一次快速前向传播，理想情况下仅凭物理规律即可训练，无需标注数据。DeepOHeat-v1 使此类替代模型既快速又可信，但仅适用于低对比度几何结构。高对比度多裸片堆叠会在两方面使其失效：非连续电导率使连续物理损失在材料界面处失去良定义性；同时病态性（$\kappa_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$）使离散化强形式损失超出了一阶优化的适用范围。我们提出 DeepOHeat-v2 以同时克服这两个问题。首先，我们训练一个离散化物理损失，它天然处理不连续性；其能量形式将预测空间上的损失-海森条件数从 $\kappa^2$ 降至 $\kappa$，而矩阵预条件优化器将平均峰值温度误差从超过 30 K 降至 0.55 K。其次，由于优化会偏离训练分布，我们提出一个自改进框架：热点信任门将标记的布局方案送至参考求解器，替代模型在精化解上增量式重训练，并且仅在改进了留出验证误差时才保留更新。在多裸片基准测试上，返回设计对应的替代模型与真实峰值温度差距从 1.12 K 降至 0.11 K，与逐步求解优化器精度相当，同时运行速度快 $56\times$。

title: Comparing the Quality of Code Generated by Vibe Coding Tools
authors: Gustavo da Mota, Kiev Gama
publish: arXiv
abstract: The use of AI agents for automatic code generation has become increasingly common in software development. However, concerns remain about the quality of the generated code, including aspects of maintainability, readability, and long-term evolution. This study compares the structural quality of code produced by three widely adopted vibe coding tools --- Lovable, v0, and Replit --- starting from a single generation prompt. We generate three independent projects per tool, totalling nine web applications, and submit them to static analysis with SonarQube. We collect metrics such as the number of issues, severity distribution, estimated remediation effort, cyclomatic and cognitive complexity, and code duplication. Preliminary results show that the tools exhibit distinct qualitative profiles: Lovable concentrates issues of lower severity but presents a substantially higher density of code smells per KLOC, while v0 and Replit produce more code with more aggressive severity profiles. These findings suggest that choosing between vibe coding tools involves structural trade-offs that go beyond perceived productivity.
title_zh: 比较Vibe Coding工具生成的代码质量
abstract_zh: 在软件开发中，使用AI代理进行自动代码生成已日益普遍。然而，人们对所生成代码的质量仍存有担忧，包括可维护性、可读性以及长期演进等方面。本研究比较了三种广泛采用的“vibe coding”工具——Lovable、v0和Replit——从单个生成提示出发所生成代码的结构化质量。我们为每个工具生成三个独立项目，共九个Web应用程序，并将它们提交给SonarQube进行静态分析。我们收集了诸如问题数量、严重程度分布、预计修复工作量、圈复杂度和认知复杂度以及代码重复等指标。初步结果表明，这些工具呈现出截然不同的定性特征：Lovable集中的问题严重程度较低，但每千行代码的代码异味密度明显更高；而v0和Replit生成的代码更多，且严重程度特征更为突出。这些发现表明，在“vibe coding”工具之间进行选择涉及超出感知生产力范畴的结构性权衡。

title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs
authors: Andrew Borthwick
publish: arXiv
abstract: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed agent; and an operator-chosen per-problem cost target - usually set at an incumbent's own price - RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent, evolves complete agent programs that attack the public frontiers of two semantically dissimilar tasks point by point: DS-1000 (execution-checked code generation) and PaperFindingBench (LLM-judged scientific document retrieval). Our officially scored submissions hold every Pareto-frontier slot but one on the two tasks' leaderboards, including Pareto domination of both the top-scoring and the lowest-cost competing points.
title_zh: 通过智能体进化在大语言模型菜单上实现各个价位的竞争
abstract_zh: 设想一家公司针对某一特定智能体任务调研其竞争对手，并力求在每个竞争对手的价格点上提供更高的准确性。一家能在帕累托意义上支配其竞争对手的公司，不会让任何理性客户有理由转向别处购买。本文展示了一条实现这种能力的路径：通过在大语言模型菜单上进行智能体进化，且所使用的训练池最多只有100个示例。给定一个包含九个LLM端点的定价菜单；任务、目标和API的简要文档；一个简单的种子智能体；以及由操作者为每个问题设定的成本目标——通常设为现有参与者的价格——RoboPhD（一个进化型元智能体）会进化出完整的智能体程序，逐一攻克两个语义迥异任务的公开前沿：DS-1000（执行校验的代码生成）和PaperFindingBench（由LLM评判的科学文献检索）。我们经官方评分的提交在这两个任务的排行榜上占据了除一个之外的所有帕累托前沿位置，包括对得分最高和成本最低的竞争点的帕累托支配。

title: Decorrelation Is Not Complementarity: Skill, Not Lineage, Governs Trusted-Monitor Ensembles
authors: Anik Jha
publish: arXiv
abstract: Trusted monitoring has a cheap, trusted model score a stronger untrusted model's actions, and a diverse ensemble of them beats a single stronger monitor at matched cost. They are built by minimising average pairwise correlation, and that paper's twelve monitors shared one base model, leaving open what supplies the diversity. We study 24 open-weight monitors spanning nine pretraining lineages and a 29x range of detection skill (pAUC at 10 percent FPR, 0.028 to 0.803) on backdoored code. The metric used to build panels does not predict what a panel is for, and we can say why. Agreement on attack items splits into a shared-detectability signal component and an idiosyncratic error component, which predict ensemble gain with opposite sign (Spearman -0.25 and +0.26), so their sum, the metric actually used, predicts it barely at all (+0.05); the cancellation holds in 7 of 8 evaluations. Skill acts on signal (+0.53) while error stays flat (-0.01), which is why a monitor's own skill predicts its agreement with the pool (Spearman 0.84, n = 24, permutation p below 0.0001). Pretraining lineage is the obvious way to buy decorrelation, and it does not pay. At matched member capability, cross-lineage panels detect no better (permutation p = 0.13), and lineage barely moves the metric either (+0.064, p = 0.18). We report that against ourselves: on our own 22-monitor pool the same test read +0.104 at p = 0.037 until two monitors were added. An earlier pool topping out at pAUC 0.23 had already invalidated another analysis. Such a quantity is a property of the pool assembled. Panel gain over the best member falls monotonically with panel skill (-0.66 at k = 2, -0.70 at k = 3), and no correlation-weighted selection beats picking the single best monitor out of sample. Across six attacker models the gain result holds in all six, the agreement and cancellation results in five of six.
title_zh: 去相关并非互补性：决定可信监控集成的是技能，而非谱系
abstract_zh: 可信监控使用一个廉价且可信的模型来对更强的不可信模型的行为进行评分，而由这些模型组成的多样化集成在同等成本下胜过单个更强的监控器。它们是通过最小化平均成对相关性来构建的，而那篇论文中的十二个监控器共享一个基础模型，使得多样性来源悬而未决。我们研究了24个开放权重监控器，它们跨越九个预训练谱系，在带有后门的代码上的检测技能范围达29倍（10%假阳性率下的pAUC，从0.028到0.803）。用于构建面板的指标并不能预测面板的用途，而且我们能说明原因。对攻击样本的一致性可分解为共享可检测性信号成分和特质性误差成分，它们以相反的符号预测集成增益（Spearman -0.25 和 +0.26），因此它们的总和——即实际使用的指标——几乎完全无法预测它（+0.05）；这种抵消在8项评估中的7项中成立。技能作用于信号（+0.53），而误差保持平稳（-0.01），这就是为什么监控器自身的技能能预测其与池的一致性（Spearman 0.84，n = 24，置换p值低于0.0001）。预训练谱系是获得去相关的明显途径，但并不划算。在成员能力匹配的情况下，跨谱系面板的检测效果并未更好（置换p = 0.13），谱系对指标的影响也微乎其微（+0.064，p = 0.18）。我们以自身为对照报告这一点：在我们自己的22个监控器池上，加入两个监控器之前，同样的检验读数为+0.104，p = 0.037。一个早先的池，其pAUC最高为0.23，已经使另一项分析失效。这样的量是所组装池的一个属性。面板相对于最佳成员的增益随面板技能单调下降（k = 2 时为 -0.66，k = 3 时为 -0.70），并且没有任何相关性加权选择能胜过在样本外挑选单个最佳监控器。在六个攻击者模型中，增益结果在全部六个中成立，一致性和抵消结果在六个中的五个中成立。

title: ModBench: A Pipeline for Building Modelica Benchmark Datasets Mined from Library Repositories
authors: Masoud Sadrnezhaad, Martin Sjölund, Adrian Pop, José Antonio Hernández López, Torvald Mårtensson, Dániel Varró
publish: arXiv
abstract: Research on equation-based cyber-physical systems modeling languages, such as Modelica, is constrained by the lack of curated benchmark datasets. This limits empirical insight into the evolution and development of models. We address this gap with ModBench, a pipeline that mines Git repositories of Modelica libraries to produce benchmark datasets of model snapshots. The pipeline (1) filters repository commits to retain human-authored, Modelica-relevant revisions; (2) extracts simulation-eligible classes; and (3) builds canonical representations of Modelica classes. For empirical validation, we applied ModBench to the Modelica Standard Library (MSL) and report the resulting dataset, spanning the full commit history (since Modelica language v3), with 85,562 distinct class snapshots, and links enabling traceability to original models and Git metadata. The dataset, its API, and the data generation pipeline are publicly available to support future research on model evolution analysis, compiler testing, and automated model repair or generation.
title_zh: ModBench：从库仓库中挖掘构建Modelica基准数据集的流水线
abstract_zh: 基于方程的物理信息系统建模语言（如 Modelica）的研究受限于缺乏精选的基准数据集，这限制了对模型演化与发展的实证洞察。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了 ModBench，一个通过挖掘 Modelica 库的 Git 仓库来生成模型快照基准数据集的流水线。该流水线：（1）筛选仓库提交，保留人工编写且与 Modelica 相关的修订；（2）提取可仿真的类；（3）构建 Modelica 类的规范化表示。为进行实证验证，我们将 ModBench 应用于 Modelica 标准库（MSL），并报告了生成的数据集。该数据集覆盖自 Modelica 语言 v3 以来的完整提交历史，包含 85,562 个不同的类快照，并提供可追溯至原始模型及 Git 元数据的链接。该数据集、其 API 及数据生成流水线均已公开，以支持未来在模型演化分析、编译器测试以及自动模型修复或生成方面的研究。

title: Validating HTTP Semantics in REST APIs With Constructed Call Sequence Scenarios
authors: Omur Sahin, Andrea Arcuri
publish: arXiv
abstract: Context: REST APIs are widely used in industry. These APIs use HTTP for their communications. Failures in following the specifications of HTTP can lead to confusing and hard to use APIs, with possibly serious software faults with dire consequences. Objectives: Define novel automated techniques to automatically find HTTP semantics-level faults in existing REST APIs. Methods: We extended the state-of-the-art fuzzer EvoMaster with 9 new oracles to detect HTTP semanticslevel faults. Once the standard fuzzing process is finished generating N test cases, a new phase is executed in which these N tests are used as a starting point to create new scenarios (i.e., new sequences of HTTP calls) aimed at validating specific HTTP properties defined in these 9 oracles. Results: Experiments on 9 artificial APIs with inject faults show that our novel techniques can successfully detect all of them. Further experiments on 36 APIs from the WFD corpus show that our novel techniques can automatically find 166 existing faults in these real-world APIs. Conclusion: REST APIs use HTTP, and, as such, they need to follow its semantics to avoid misleading their clients and introducing subtle software faults. The novel techniques presented in this paper are shown to be effective at automatically finding several of this type of faults.
title_zh: 在 REST API 中通过构造的调用序列场景验证 HTTP 语义
abstract_zh: **背景：** REST API 在工业界被广泛使用。这些 API 使用 HTTP 进行通信。未能遵循 HTTP 规范可能导致 API 令人困惑且难以使用，并可能引发后果严重的软件故障。**目标：** 定义新颖的自动化技术，以自动发现现有 REST API 中 HTTP 语义级别的故障。**方法：** 我们扩展了最先进的模糊测试工具 EvoMaster，新增了 9 个预言器（oracles）来检测 HTTP 语义级故障。当标准模糊测试过程生成 N 个测试用例后，将执行一个新阶段，以这 N 个测试为起点创建新的场景（即新的 HTTP 调用序列），旨在验证这 9 个预言器中定义的特定 HTTP 属性。**结果：** 在 9 个注入故障的人工 API 上进行的实验表明，我们的新技术可以成功检测出所有故障。进一步在 WFD 语料库中 36 个 API 上进行的实验表明，我们的新技术能够在这些真实世界的 API 中自动发现 166 个现有故障。**结论：** REST API 使用 HTTP，因此需要遵循其语义，以避免误导客户端并引入微妙的软件故障。本文提出的新技术在自动发现此类故障方面被证明是有效的。

title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks
authors: Bardia Mohammadi, Lars Klein, Aman Chadha, Akhil Arora, Laurent Bindschaedler
publish: arXiv
abstract: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels empty, and putting the facts in the prompt restores success. When a rename defeats what models memorized about a real library, all seven fail in the same place, passing and missing the same tests. Availability decides the outcome and distance does not: withholding a fact costs exactly the work it supports, and a supplied fact works as well far from the edit as next to it. Harnesses pay unequal prices for it: configurations that all pass every test differ more than tenfold in tokens consumed because they rebuild the same content at different rates, and spending more recovers nothing when facts are withheld. A missing fact produces wrong work rather than absent work: an agent asked to act acts, fabricating the file or guessing the value, so instruments built on reads look for a hole already filled. How often it says it is blocked instead is a property of the model, from every trial to none. Availability does not settle every edit: where standard and code disagree, agents follow the standard even when it prescribes the worse code, so a stale convention file costs more than no file. Because parametric memory substitutes for reading, on SWE-bench, where models likely know the repositories, reads no longer predict success. Harnesses should keep the facts an edit depends on available when the agent writes, and check that availability against what the agent produces rather than what it reads.
title_zh: 编码代理的工作集：仓库级任务中的一致性债务
abstract_zh: 仓库规模的编码要求智能体在有限的上下文窗口内保持测试、导入、配置和迁移规则的一致性。我们将其建模为重建一个耦合事实图：每次编辑时，所需的事实来自最近的上下文或参数记忆，而两者都未覆盖的事实则构成一致性债务。我们在七个模型和五个测试框架中提供或屏蔽每种通道，并注入故障。正如预期，当两种通道都为空时，没有模型能在未见过的API上完成任务，而将事实放入提示中则能恢复成功。当一次重命名使模型对真实库的记忆失效时，所有七个模型都在同一处失败，通过和未通过的测试完全相同。可用性决定结果，而距离不起作用：屏蔽一个事实所付出的代价恰好等于它所支持的工作量，而提供的事实无论远离编辑点还是紧邻编辑点都同样有效。测试框架为此付出的代价并不相同：所有配置都能通过所有测试，但它们消耗的令牌数相差十倍以上，因为它们以不同的速率重建相同的内容，而当事实被屏蔽时，花费更多也一无所获。缺失的事实产生错误的工作而非缺失的工作：被要求行动的智能体会行动，伪造文件或猜测值，因此基于读取的检测工具寻找的漏洞已被填补。它声称被阻塞的频率则是模型的一种属性，从每次尝试都阻塞到从不阻塞不等。可用性并不能决定每一次编辑：当标准与代码不一致时，智能体会遵循标准，即使标准规定的是较差的代码，因此过时的约定文件比没有文件代价更高。由于参数记忆可以替代读取，在模型可能已经了解代码库的SWE-bench上，读取行为不再能预测成功。测试框架应在智能体编写时保持编辑所依赖的事实可用，并根据智能体产生的内容而非读取的内容来检查这种可用性。

title: Palmyra x6 Technical Report: An Agentic, Tool-Use Model Post-Trained via Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning
authors: Peng Du, Kiran Kamble, Rakshith Vasudev, Zhizhuo Yang, Rohith Nadimpally, Arjun Krishna, Waseem Alshikh, Daniel M. Bikel
publish: arXiv
abstract: Palmyra x6 is a large language model optimized for use with enterprise-oriented agentic tasks. The model was built by post-training a Mixture-of-Experts base model with Anchored Supervised Fine-Tuning on a compact corpus of verified, synthetic tool-use trajectories, optimized with a Muon + Adam hybrid. The recipe is deliberately conservative and deliberately controlled: 626 trajectories, a single epoch, a low learning rate, and a KL anchor to the frozen base. The model shows substantial gains over the previous default model for Writer Agent, and compares favorably with several recent models on public benchmarks, scoring the highest on BFCL Core at $0.785$ and posts the highest six-benchmark mean of the cohort. Furthermore, the model has shown itself to be competitive or leading relative to comparators in our bias and safety evaluations.
title_zh: Palmyra x6 技术报告：一种通过锚定监督微调后训练的智能体工具使用模型
abstract_zh: Palmyra x6是一款针对面向企业的智能体任务进行优化的大型语言模型。该模型通过对一个专家混合基础模型进行后训练构建而成，采用锚定监督微调方法，在一个紧凑的、经过验证的合成工具使用轨迹语料库上进行训练，并使用Muon与Adam混合优化器进行优化。其训练策略刻意保守且刻意受控：626条轨迹、单轮训练、低学习率，并以KL散度锚定至冻结的基础模型。与Writer Agent此前使用的默认模型相比，该模型展现了显著提升，并在公开基准测试中与近期推出的数款模型相比表现优异——在BFCL Core上取得最高分$0.785$，同时在同类模型中六项基准均值排名第一。此外，在我们的偏见与安全评估中，该模型展现出与对照模型相比具有竞争力或处于领先地位。

title: DCI: Dependency Confidence Index for Assessing Open-Source Dependency Trustworthiness
authors: Clemens Albrecht, Stefan Reitmann
publish: arXiv
abstract: Selecting trustworthy open source software dependencies remains a major challenge in software supply chain security. We present the Dependency Confidence Index (DCI), a composite formative index that combines nine empirically weighted trust factors into a single normalized composite score for dependency selection. DCI's trust factors combine insights from a systematic literature review and an exploratory Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) survey of ten software developers, highlighting security, source code quality, and project health as the most influential dimensions. Following Goal-Question-Metric methodology, we implemented 12 automated measurements using SonarQube, GitHub APIs, and OpenSSF Scorecard data, deployed in a containerized evaluation platform. We conducted a pilot evaluation of the normalized DCI on 92 popular PyPI packages, observing moderate agreement with OpenSSF Scorecard scores and perfect test--retest reliability. Analysis reveals process-based factors (dependency management, CI) dominate scores on high-quality packages, while security metrics saturate---suggesting DCI's complementary role to existing tools. Our publicly available implementation provides a foundation for open source software trustworthiness research and practical dependency auditing.
title_zh: DCI：依赖置信指数，用于评估开源依赖的可信度
abstract_zh: 选择可信的开源软件依赖仍然是软件供应链安全中的一项重大挑战。我们提出了依赖置信指数（DCI），这是一个复合形成性指数，将九个经验加权的信任因子组合成一个归一化的复合评分，用于依赖选择。DCI的信任因子结合了系统性文献综述和一项对十名软件开发者的探索性层次分析法（AHP）调查的见解，强调安全、源代码质量和项目健康是最有影响力的维度。遵循目标-问题-度量（GQM）方法，我们使用SonarQube、GitHub API和OpenSSF Scorecard数据实现了12项自动化测量，并部署在容器化评估平台上。我们对92个流行的PyPI软件包进行了归一化DCI的试点评估，观察到与OpenSSF Scorecard评分的适度一致性以及完美的重测信度。分析显示，在高品质软件包上，基于过程的因子（依赖管理、持续集成）主导了评分，而安全指标趋于饱和——这表明DCI对现有工具具有补充作用。我们公开可用的实现为开源软件可信度研究和实际依赖审计提供了基础。

title: GoalEvolve: From Handcrafted Algorithm Priors to Goal-Driven Evolution of Physical Design Algorithms
authors: Haixu Liu, Lei Zhou, Yuhao Ren, Yumao Wu, Zhiang Wang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Physical design algorithms operate within tightly coupled, multi-stage optimization flows, where stage-local gains may vanish or induce downstream degradation. Existing program-evolution frameworks often rely on stage-local objectives or undifferentiated multi-metric feedback, which neither guarantee better final results nor identify which unmet requirement should guide the next iteration. We present GoalEvolve, a goal-driven framework that makes physical design algorithm evolution accountable for the final quality of results (QoR) of the complete flow. Given a multi-objective QoR target region, GoalEvolve converts unmet requirements into normalized target gaps, identifies the dominant bottleneck, and uses stage-resolved checkpoint evidence to locate the responsible stage. An LLM-based Teacher then narrows the search to a relevant algorithmic decision and source region, while parallel Student agents implement and validate hypotheses through full-flow evaluation. Local effects, optimization debt, and downstream retention are retained as mechanism evidence for subsequent evolution. Across eight ASAP7 designs, GoalEvolve improves post-route TNS by 30.67% on average and reduces leakage and dynamic power by 21.18% and 9.42% versus default OpenROAD. Relative to commercial-tool goals, it closes 62.20% of the normalized power gap on power-dominant designs, surpasses the TNS goals on both timing-dominant designs, and closes 32.48% of the equal-weight timing-power gap on joint designs. Across all three designs evaluated against Codex goal mode under matched budgets, GoalEvolve further improves TNS by 26.46% while reducing leakage and dynamic power by 12.38% and 0.76%, respectively.
title_zh: GoalEvolve：从手工设计的算法先验到目标驱动的物理设计算法演化
abstract_zh: 物理设计算法运行在紧密耦合的多阶段优化流程中，阶段局部收益可能消失或引发下游退化。现有的程序演化框架通常依赖阶段局部目标或无差别的多指标反馈，这既不能保证更好的最终结果，也无法识别哪个未满足的需求应指导下一次迭代。我们提出 GoalEvolve，一个目标驱动的框架，使物理设计算法的演化对完整流程的最终结果质量（QoR）负责。给定一个多目标 QoR 目标区域，GoalEvolve 将未满足的需求转化为归一化目标差距，识别主导瓶颈，并利用阶段级检查点证据定位责任阶段。随后，基于 LLM 的教师模型将搜索范围缩小到相关的算法决策和源码区域，同时并行的学生代理通过全流程评估实现并验证假设。局部效应、优化债务和下游保留率作为机制证据保留下来，供后续演化使用。在 8 个 ASAP7 设计上，与默认 OpenROAD 相比，GoalEvolve 将布线后 TNS 平均提高 30.67%，并将泄漏功耗和动态功耗分别降低 21.18% 和 9.42%。相对于商业工具目标，它在功耗主导设计上消除了 62.20% 的归一化功耗差距，在两个时序主导设计上均超过了 TNS 目标，并在联合设计上弥合了等权重时序-功耗差距的 32.48%。在匹配预算下，针对所有三个与 Codex 目标模式对照评估的设计，GoalEvolve 进一步将 TNS 提高 26.46%，同时将泄漏功耗和动态功耗分别降低 12.38% 和 0.76%。

title: zenDot: An LLM-integrated quantum TCAD platform for semiconductor quantum-device design and optimization automation
authors: Zeheng Wang, Yan Liu, Yue Hao, Genquan Han
publish: arXiv
abstract: Semiconductor quantum-device design still lacks an integrated Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD)-like environment that connects material geometry, quantum many-body simulation, and automated design. Here we introduce zenDot, a large-language model (LLM)-integrated quantum TCAD platform that links a material-labelled device state to a unified condensed-matter physics toolbox. The device and calculation components are integrated into a desktop workbench, Python API, and an embedded LLM agent, allowing electrostatics, charge and transport characterization, correlated-state calculations, and qubit modelling to be executed within one reproducible environment. We demonstrate zenDot on a Si/SiO2 double quantum dot, where a single device state reproduces the characterization workflow and supports hybrid, tunnel-charge, and singlet-triplet qubit analyses. A platform-level universal-control scan revises the singlet-triplet operating point and reduces the predicted worst-gate infidelity by nearly 30-fold. Beyond analysis, the LLM agent directly operates the same physics environment as human users, proposing design changes, executing registered simulations, and iterating on solver-returned metrics under physics-aware validation. Across three demonstration tasks it completes 18 validated design iterations, including geometry modification followed by a full re-solve from the material stack. zenDot establishes a machine-operable quantum TCAD workflow that connects device physics with LLM-driven design exploration.
title_zh: zenDot：面向半导体量子器件设计与优化自动化的LLM集成量子TCAD平台
abstract_zh: 半导体量子器件设计仍然缺乏一个集成的类技术计算机辅助设计（TCAD）环境，用以连接材料几何结构、量子多体模拟与自动化设计。在此，我们推出zenDot——一个集成大语言模型（LLM）的量子TCAD平台，将材料标注的器件状态与统一的凝聚态物理工具库相连接。器件与计算组件被集成到桌面工作台、Python应用程序接口（API）以及内嵌的LLM智能体中，使得静电学、电荷与输运表征、关联态计算和量子比特建模均可在同一可复现环境中执行。我们在Si/SiO₂双量子点上对zenDot进行了演示，单个器件状态即可复现表征工作流，并支持混合、隧穿电荷和单重态-三重态量子比特分析。平台级的通用控制扫描修正了单重态-三重态工作点，并将预测的最差门不保真度降低了近30倍。除分析之外，LLM智能体还能像人类用户一样直接操作同一物理环境，提出设计变更、执行已注册的模拟，并在物理感知验证下对求解器返回的度量指标进行迭代优化。在三个演示任务中，它完成了18次经过验证的设计迭代，包括几何修改以及对材料堆叠的完整重新求解。zenDot建立了一种可机器操作的量子TCAD工作流，将器件物理与LLM驱动的设计探索相连接。

title: OpenHarmony Bench: Evaluating LLMs and Coding Agents on OpenHarmony App Development
authors: Li Li, Han Hu, Tianjian Zhang, Xin Peng, Fangzhu Mao, Qingyu Zhang, Xiaoheng Xie, Zhongmin Tang, Zhihao Lin, Haolin Ruan, Miaomiao Dong, Liuchuan Zhu, Yue Li, Chi Chen, Wenkang Zhong, Mingfei Zhang, Yang Yu, Bo Sun, Chaorui Zhang, Weixi Zhang, Wei Han, Bo Bai, Kui Liu, Gang Fan, Siru Liu, Jiaqian Zhou, Jiali Sun, Yunbiao Dong, Wenhao Zhong, Yunhong Xu
publish: arXiv
abstract: We present OPENHARMONY BENCH, an app-level coding benchmark for evaluating LLM-based coding agents on OpenHarmony ArkTS applications. Unlike function-level benchmarks, it evaluates complete app-level changes: each task requires an agent to modify a buildable ArkTS project so that a requested behavior works end to end, involving UI state, data persistence, build configuration, and platform APIs. The benchmark installs and drives the delivered application on a device to check whether the behavior is observable. It covers three input sources: natural-language feature requests (new-feature), structured scenario specifications (spec-driven), and bug descriptions (bug-fix). The benchmark contains 153 top-level tasks and 242 Feature points (F-points), where an F-point is one executable behavior check. The snapshot includes 32 new-feature tasks, 50 spec-driven tasks with 139 F-points, and 71 bug-fix tasks. The main leaderboard is scored over top-level tasks rather than independently weighted F-points. We describe the benchmark construction, statistics, and build-and-test evaluation pipeline, and evaluate DevEco Code with eight LLMs across three independent full-suite runs per configuration. Three findings emerge. First, newer generations complete more tasks than their predecessors within evaluated model-family pairs. Second, buildability is close to saturated while behavioral correctness is not: mean Final Build Success Rate is 94.77% to 100.00%, whereas mean Task Completion is 48.36% to 58.39%. Third, spec-driven tasks have the lowest Task Completion under all-checks task scoring, with no configuration exceeding 35%. The code, data, tasks, reference solutions, tests, evaluation scripts, and leaderboard are released through the official OPENHARMONY BENCH website at https://bench.matrix.openharmony.cn/.
title_zh: OpenHarmony Bench：评估 LLMs 与编码智能体在 OpenHarmony 应用开发中的表现
abstract_zh: 我们提出OPENHARMONY BENCH，这是一个应用级编码基准，用于评估基于LLM的编码智能体在OpenHarmony ArkTS应用上的表现。与函数级基准不同，它评估完整的应用级变更：每个任务都要求智能体修改一个可构建的ArkTS工程，使所请求的行为端到端地正常工作，涉及UI状态、数据持久化、构建配置和平台API。该基准在设备上安装并驱动交付的应用，以检查该行为是否可观察。它涵盖三种输入来源：自然语言功能需求（新功能）、结构化场景规格说明（规格驱动）和Bug描述（缺陷修复）。该基准包含153个顶级任务和242个功能点（F-point），其中每个F-point对应一项可执行的行为检查。快照包含32个新功能任务、50个规格驱动任务（含139个F-point）和71个缺陷修复任务。主排行榜按顶级任务计分，而非按独立加权的F-point计分。我们描述了基准构建、统计信息以及构建与测试评估流水线，并使用八个LLM对DevEco Code进行了评估，每种配置下进行三次独立的全量套件运行。由此得出三个发现。首先，在受评估的模型家族内部配对中，新一代模型比前代完成了更多任务。其次，可构建性已接近饱和，而行为正确性尚未饱和：平均最终构建成功率为94.77%至100.00%，而平均任务完成率为48.36%至58.39%。第三，在全检查任务计分方式下，规格驱动任务的任务完成率最低，所有配置均未超过35%。代码、数据、任务、参考解决方案、测试、评估脚本和排行榜均已通过OPENHARMONY BENCH官方网站https://bench.matrix.openharmony.cn/发布。

title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
authors: Parsa Mazaheri, Kasra Mazaheri
publish: arXiv
abstract: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.
title_zh: 先前的审计-修复情境使LLM验证器的阈值向宽松方向偏移。
abstract_zh: 自动化检查流水线日益将一个语言模型设为检查者，另一个（或同一个）设为修复者。我们探究这种连接方式是否会改变检查者所报告的内容。在人类验证为正确的 ProcessBench 轨迹上、并保持当前任务逐字节相同的条件下测量误报，我们发现：当上下文中已经存在一个完整的“审计→修复”回合时，15/15 的模型×措辞组合误报率均下降，与长度匹配的非审计对照相比降低 2.8 到 11.5 个百分点，相对该对照减少 9% 到 25%。这一方向与累积消息文献的预测相反：在该操纵能够干净落地的模型上，审计报告了错误的回合会进一步降低误报率——五种措辞全部如此，尽管负性不对称会预测更多标记。对该回合进行分解后发现，修复内容与审计结论具有互补性：不同成分在不同模型家族上承载该效应。信号检测分析将变化定位于阈值而非区分度——判据在 15/15 种组合中发生移动，并在 13 种组合中经校正后仍稳健，而 d′ 在任何组合中都不稳健，尽管 d′ 检验在构造上灵敏度只有其一半。对 50 个误报的人工审计发现，82% 纯属错误，因此在当前操作点，这一偏移未必有害。启用推理后，在接受测试的两个模型上，该效应保持其相对大小，且阈值解读在那里依然成立。

title: Implicit, Yet Impactful: Understanding Hidden Dependencies in Java Projects
authors: Lyuye Zhang, Chengwei Liu, Fangyuan Zhang, Yiran Zhang, Yuan Zhou, Yang Liu
publish: arXiv
abstract: As software usage continues to expand, package managers automatically resolve dependencies to construct a dependency graph based on user-specified requirements. These explicitly declared dependencies, known as direct dependencies, receive significant attention in terms of maintainability and security. However, implicit dependencies, which are not explicitly defined by users but are still directly utilized or referenced in their project code due to oversight, remain largely unnoticed. Unlike ordinary transitive dependencies, which may remain unused and invisible to the root, implicit dependencies are actively used yet undeclared, leaving their versions outside the project's direct control. This lack of awareness poses substantial challenges related to security and maintainability. In this study, we present the first study to treat implicit dependencies as the focal phenomenon and quantitatively characterize their lifecycle consequences for the Maven ecosystem. We meticulously collected and built a large-scale dataset with 1,157 libraries with 19,812 versions from the Maven Central Repository and 972 modules from GitHub. Our findings reveal that 34.12% of the analyzed dataset contains implicit dependencies, with two primary causes identified as key contributors to the issue. Among these, 48% introduce breaking changes due to version drift, and 36 CVEs have vulnerable methods directly used by root projects; 30.28% of implicit dependencies are affected by known vulnerabilities under the version-range convention SCA tools use for declared dependencies. Finally, we identified and analyzed four major countermeasures, providing actionable insights and practical implications for addressing this overlooked issue for stakeholders within the OSS ecosystem.
title_zh: 隐式却影响深远：理解Java项目中的隐藏依赖
abstract_zh: 随着软件使用范围的持续扩大，包管理器会根据用户指定的需求自动解析依赖关系，并构建相应的依赖图。这些被显式声明的依赖称为直接依赖，其在可维护性和安全性方面受到了广泛关注。然而，隐式依赖——即那些并非用户显式定义，却因疏忽而在项目代码中被直接使用或引用的依赖——在很大程度上仍然未被重视。与可能保持未使用状态且对根项目不可见的普通传递依赖不同，隐式依赖是被积极使用却未声明的，这使得它们的版本超出了项目的直接控制范围。这种认知缺失给安全性和可维护性带来了重大挑战。在本研究中，我们首次将隐式依赖作为核心现象进行系统研究，并定量刻画了它们对Maven生态系统所带来的生命周期影响。我们精心收集并构建了一个大规模数据集，其中包含来自Maven中央仓库的1,157个库的19,812个版本，以及来自GitHub的972个模块。我们的研究结果显示，所分析的数据集中有34.12%包含隐式依赖，并确定了导致该问题的两个主要原因。其中，48%的隐式依赖因版本漂移而引入了破坏性变更，且有36个CVE的易受攻击方法被根项目直接使用；在SCA工具对已声明依赖所采用的版本范围约定下，30.28%的隐式依赖受到已知漏洞的影响。最后，我们识别并分析了四种主要对策，为开源软件生态系统中的利益相关者解决这一被忽视的问题提供了可操作的见解和实际启示。

title: Securing AI-Generated Code: A Just-in-Time Vulnerability Detection and Remediation Pipeline
authors: Mikhail Surikov
publish: arXiv
abstract: AI-assisted development tools generate vulnerable code at significant rates, yet few automated mechanisms exist to detect, enrich, fix, and verify security issues at development velocity, particularly ones that ground remediation in real-world threat context. This paper presents an automated security evaluation pipeline that generates Python code from LLMSecEval prompts, scans for vulnerabilities using CodeQL and Bandit in parallel with an independent Code Validator LLM, enriches the Code Validator findings with MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CWE Observed Examples, and Python best practice guidelines, generates fixes via the Code Generation LLM, and re-scans with CodeQL and Bandit to verify outcomes. Two pipeline configurations were evaluated: Pipeline 1 (P1), using enriched Code Validator findings only, and Pipeline 2 (P2), where it additionally receives the initial CodeQL and Bandit findings. Both configurations were run across four Claude models: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5, producing 80 runs against 26 LLMSecEval prompts covering 9 CWE categories. P1 reduced static analyzer findings across all four models, ranging from -9% (Opus 4.8) to -54% (Sonnet 5). P2 deepened these reductions further, ranging from -29% (Opus 4.8) to -69% (Haiku 4.5), with P2 outperforming P1 for every model. Verdict consistency averaged approximately 81% modal agreement across all configurations, with P2 marginally more stable than P1. Remediation introduced new vulnerabilities in 15-22% of cases: roughly 70% involved a single new finding, and P2 reduced churn for three of four models, with Sonnet 5 as the sole exception. Notably, the best Code Generation LLM (Opus 4.8) was not the best pipeline performer, as Sonnet 4.6 produced the lowest residual findings and highest pass rate after P2 remediation, suggesting that pipeline effectiveness and first-draft security are distinct properties.
title_zh: 确保AI生成代码的安全：即时漏洞检测与修复流水线
abstract_zh: AI辅助开发工具以显著比例生成存在漏洞的代码，然而目前几乎没有自动化机制能够在开发速度下检测、丰富、修复并验证安全问题，尤其是能够将修复措施植根于真实世界威胁背景的机制。本文提出了一种自动化安全评估流水线，该流水线从LLMSecEval提示词生成Python代码，使用CodeQL和Bandit并行扫描漏洞，同时以独立的Code Validator LLM进行验证，将Code Validator的发现结果与MITRE ATT&CK技术、CWE实际示例及Python最佳实践指南相结合，通过Code Generation LLM生成修复方案，并再次使用CodeQL和Bandit重新扫描以验证修复结果。研究评估了两种流水线配置：流水线1（P1），仅使用经过丰富的Code Validator发现结果；流水线2（P2），额外接收初始的CodeQL和Bandit发现结果。两种配置均在四个Claude模型上运行：Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4.6、Sonnet 5和Haiku 4.5，共针对覆盖9个CWE类别的26个LLMSecEval提示词进行了80次运行。P1在所有四个模型上均减少了静态分析器发现结果，减少幅度从-9%（Opus 4.8）到-54%（Sonnet 5）不等。P2进一步加深了这些减少幅度，从-29%（Opus 4.8）到-69%（Haiku 4.5）不等，且每个模型的P2表现均优于P1。判定一致性在所有配置中平均约为81%的众数一致性，P2比P1略为稳定。修复在15%-22%的案例中引入了新漏洞：其中约70%涉及单个新发现，且P2在四个模型中的三个上减少了变更量，Sonnet 5是唯一例外。值得注意的是，最佳Code Generation LLM（Opus 4.8）并非流水线表现最佳的模型，Sonnet 4.6在P2修复后产生了最低的残留发现结果和最高的通过率，这表明流水线有效性与首稿安全性是两种不同的属性。
